title: Formal testacy proceedings; vacation of order for other cause.
bodyText: For good cause shown, an order in a formal testacy proceeding may be modified or vacated within the time allowed for appeal.
bodyHtml: §560:3-413  Formal testacy proceedings; vacation of order for other cause.  For good cause shown, an order in a formal testacy proceeding may be modified or vacated within the time allowed for appeal. [L 1996, c 288, pt of §1]
